[Section] Corpus
[source_id=24] Spoken-SQuAD is chosen as the target domain data for training and testing. Spoken-SQuAD BIBREF5 is an automatically generated corpus in which the document is in spoken form and the question is in text form. The reference transcriptions are from SQuAD BIBREF1 . There are 37,111 and 5,351 question answer pairs in the training and testing sets respectively, and the word error rate (WER) of both sets is around 22.7%.
[source_id=25] The original SQuAD, Text-SQuAD, is chosen as the source domain data, where only question answering pairs appearing in Spoken-SQuAD are utilized. In our task setting, during training we train the proposed QA model on both Text-SQuAD and Spoken-SQuAD training sets. While in the testing stage, we evaluate the performance on Spoken-SQuAD testing set.

Spoken-SQuAD BIBREF5 is an automatically generated corpus in which the document is in spoken form and the question is in text form. The reference transcriptions are from SQuAD BIBREF1 . There are 37,111 and 5,351 question answer pairs in the training and testing sets respectively, and the word error rate (WER) of both sets is around 22.7%.

The original SQuAD, Text-SQuAD, is chosen as the source domain data, where only question answering pairs appearing in Spoken-SQuAD are utilized. In our task setting, during training we train the proposed QA model on both Text-SQuAD and Spoken-SQuAD training sets. While in the testing stage, we evaluate the performance on Spoken-SQuAD testing set.
